1.text: Ibyerekeye ku byo gusonzoranyiriza abera impiya nk'uko nategetse amatorero y'i Galatiya, abe ari ko namwe mukora.

2.text: Ku wa mbere w'iminsi irindi hose, umuntu wese muri mwe abike iwe ibimushobokera nk'uko atunze, kugira ngo ubwo nzaza ataba ari ho impiya zisonzoranywa.

3.text: Kandi ubwo nzasohora abo muzashima nzabatuma mbahaye inzandiko, kugira ngo abe ari bo bajyana iby'ubuntu bwanyu i Yerusalemu.

4.text: Kandi niba nanjye nzaba nkwiriye kugenda tuzajyana.

5.text: Nzabasūra nyuze i Makedoniya kuko ngambiriye kuzajya muri icyo gihugu,

6.text: kandi ahari nzamarana namwe iminsi ndetse ahari nzahamara n'igihe cy'imbeho, kugira ngo mumperekeze aho nzajya hose.

7.text: Sinshaka kubakubita urubandu none mpita, ahubwo niringiye kuzamarana namwe iminsi, Umwami wacu nankundira.

8.text: Ariko nzatinda muri Efeso kugeza kuri Pentekote,

9.text: kuko nugururiwe irembo rinini rijya mu mirimo ikomeye kandi abandwanya bakaba benshi.

10.text: Niba Timoteyo azaza muzamwemere kugira ngo abane namwe adatinya, kuko akora umurimo w'Umwami wacu nkanjye.

11.text: Nuko ntihazagire umuhinyura, ahubwo mumuherekeze mumusezerere amahoro, kugira ngo ansange kuko mutegereza ko azazana na bene Data.

12.text: Ariko ibya Apolo mwene Data, naramwinginze cyane ngo ajye iwanyu ajyane na bene Data abo, ariko ntiyakunda na hato kugenda ubu, icyakora nabona uburyo azaza.

13.text: Mube maso! Mukomerere mu byo mwizeye, mube abagabo nyabagabo mwikomeze.

15.text: Hari n'ikindi mbingingira bene Data. Muzi abo kwa Sitefana ko ari umuganura w'Abanyakaya, kandi bītangiye gukorera abera.

16.text: Nuko namwe mugandukire abameze batyo, n'undi wese ufasha umurimo wa Kristo ashishikaye.

17.text: Nishimiye yuko Sitefana na Forutunato na Akayiku baje, bamaze urukumbuzi nari mfitiye mwebwe

18.text: kuko baruhuye umutima wanjye n'uwanyu, nuko mwemere abameze batyo.

19.text: Abo mu matorero yo muri Asiya barabatashya. Akwila na Purisikila barabatashya cyane mu Mwami wacu, n'Itorero ryo mu rugo rwabo.

20.text: Bene Data bose barabatashya.Mutashyanishe guhoberana kwera.

21.text: Dore uku ni ko gutashya kwanjye Pawulo, kwanditswe n'ukwanjye kuboko.

22.text: Nihagira umuntu udakunda Umwami wacu avumwe.Umwami wacu araza!

23.text: Ubuntu bw'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo bubane namwe.

24.text: Urukundo rwanjye rubane namwe mwese muri Kristo Yesu, Amen.
